note: Pull-through park beside US 62 in Sikeston, minutes from the I-55/I-57 junction; it also sells weekly and monthly stays and RV storage. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $35 a night (+$3 booking fee once per stay), CampLife booking, year-round; 50 full-hookup pull-throughs to 40 ft (was 60 sites); electric 50 -> 30 (engine lists only 30-Amp); added showers/laundry/wifi.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: posted $35 a night (operator home page, current; CampLife quote $38 for one night incl. $3 booking fee, before tax) - passes. Gateway: none within 40 km (Memphis 201 km). Good Sam: operator silent, no stored value. Presence: operator site with phone 573-979-4921 and a CampLife engine. REVIEWS: Google Maps 4.0 stars from 147 reviews (exactly at the 4.0 line, not under); RV Life 4 stars, 55 reviews, $$. Not a drop on reviews, but borderline - I did not read the review text.

LONG-STAY (weekly $210 and monthly $500 marketed, and the CampLife blurb names 'long-term guests'): (1) $35 - pass; (2) one night sold online with no application - pass; (3) no minimum on any date read - pass; (4) one-night occupancy: 19 of 50 pull-throughs open for Tue 2026-11-17 and 21 for Wed 2026-11-18 (all 50 open on 2027 dates, likely not yet booked) - pass; (5) no homes or lots for sale - pass. Leaf-off imagery shows roughly 35 rigs on the 50 pads. Not a long-stay drop.

HOOKUPS: stored electric 50 (note prose, derived) -> 30; the CampLife site type lists '30-Amp' and the park's amenity list has no 50-Amp entry. The operator page doesn't give amperage. If a 50A site exists it isn't tagged.
SITES: stored 60 sites / 50 full-hookup (note prose) -> 50 pull-through sites on CampLife; the other 41 bookable units are storage spaces.
PIN: stored 36.9001,-89.5073 is at the entrance on US 62, ~110 m from the pad rows' centre - inside the bound, no move.
